name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A tool that automatically wraps ordinary software in a command-line interface so an AI agent can operate it directly, even if it never had one.
buyer: A software vendor or SaaS company that wants its product usable by AI agents without building a developer API from scratch.
business_use_cases: A niche software vendor (e.g. a CAD or audio tool maker) commissions a CLI wrapper so agents can automate their product, unlocking an 'AI-ready' marketing claim.
An agency offers 'agent-enablement' consulting: wrapping a client's legacy desktop tools so internal AI agents can drive them.
A developer builds and sells pre-made CLI wrappers for popular but API-less tools (old accounting or design software) through the project's community hub.

money_ideas.idea: Sell bespoke 'make my software agent-native' wrapper-building services to software vendors.
Host a paid marketplace of premium, maintained CLI wrappers beyond the free community hub.

steal_this: Pick one popular tool with no good CLI and ship a wrapper for it on the community hub this weekend to seed demand for paid custom wrappers.
